WITH purchased_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_ordered) AS purchased
    FROM order_parts
    GROUP BY component_id
),
used_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_used) AS used
    FROM (
        SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM project_components
        UNION ALL
        SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM general_usage
    ) AS combined_usage
    GROUP BY component_id
),
avg_price_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, AVG(unit_cost) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM order_parts
    GROUP BY component_id
),
total_items_cte AS (
    SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_items
    FROM components c
    LEFT JOIN categories ct ON ct.category_id = c.category_id
    LEFT JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id = c.box_id
    WHERE 
        c.name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
        OR ct.category_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
        OR b.box_label ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
)
SELECT 
    c.name,
    c.component_id AS ID,
    c.description,
    c.date_added,
    c.image_content,
    c.image_type,
    b.box_code,
    c.category_id,
    b.box_label,
    ct.category_name,
    b.box_id,
    COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) AS purchased,
    COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) AS used,
    COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) AS stock,
    total_items_cte.total_items AS totalItems,
    COALESCE(avg_price_cte.avg_unit_price, 0) AS avg_unit_price,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) > 0 
        THEN 'In Stock' 
        ELSE 'No Stock' 
    END AS status
FROM 
    components c
LEFT JOIN purchased_cte ON purchased_cte.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN used_cte ON used_cte.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN avg_price_cte ON avg_price_cte.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id = c.box_id
LEFT JOIN categories ct ON ct.category_id = c.category_id
CROSS JOIN total_items_cte
WHERE 
    c.name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
    OR ct.category_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
    OR b.box_label ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT {{ $json.params.limit }}
OFFSET {{ $json.params.offset }}

WITH purchased_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_ordered) AS purchased
    FROM order_parts
    GROUP BY component_id
),
used_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_used) AS used
    FROM (
        SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM project_components
        UNION ALL
        SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM general_usage
    ) AS combined_usage
    GROUP BY component_id
),
stock_cte AS (
  SELECT
    c.component_id,
    COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) AS stock
  FROM components c
  LEFT JOIN purchased_cte ON purchased_cte.component_id = c.component_id
  LEFT JOIN used_cte ON used_cte.component_id = c.component_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_items,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN stock > 0 THEN 1 END) AS in_stock,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN stock > 0 AND stock < 10 THEN 1 END) AS low_stock,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN stock <= 0 THEN 1 END) AS no_stock
FROM stock_cte;

SELECT 
  c.name,
  c.component_id AS id,
  c.description,
  c.date_added,
  c.image_content,
  c.image_type,
  b.box_code,
  c.category_id,
  b.box_label,
  ct.category_name,
  b.box_id,
  COALESCE(purchased.purchased, 0) AS total_purchased,
  COALESCE(used.used, 0) AS total_used,
  COALESCE(purchased.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used.used, 0) AS stock,
  COALESCE(avg_price.avg_unit_price, 0) AS avg_unit_price,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(purchased.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used.used, 0) > 0 THEN 'In Stock' ELSE 'No Stock' END AS status,
  -- Purchase history
  (SELECT json_agg(p)
   FROM (
     SELECT order_id, quantity_ordered, unit_cost, url
     FROM order_parts
     WHERE component_id = c.component_id
     ORDER BY order_id DESC
     LIMIT 10
   ) p) AS purchase_history,
  -- Project usage history always as array
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT json_agg(pr)
     FROM (
       SELECT project_id, quantity_used, date
       FROM project_components
       WHERE component_id = c.component_id
       ORDER BY date DESC
       LIMIT 10
     ) pr),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS project_usage_history,
  -- General usage history always as array
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT json_agg(gu)
     FROM (
       SELECT usage_id, quantity_used, usage_date, purpose
       FROM general_usage
       WHERE component_id = c.component_id
       ORDER BY usage_date DESC
       LIMIT 10
     ) gu),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS general_usage_history
FROM components c
LEFT JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id = c.box_id
LEFT JOIN categories ct ON ct.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_ordered) AS purchased
  FROM order_parts
  GROUP BY component_id
) purchased ON purchased.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_used) AS used
  FROM (
    SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM project_components
    UNION ALL
    SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM general_usage
  ) usage_all
  GROUP BY component_id
) used ON used.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT component_id, AVG(unit_cost) AS avg_unit_price
  FROM order_parts
  GROUP BY component_id
) avg_price ON avg_price.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE c.component_id = {{ $json.id }};

SELECT 
    c.name,
    c.component_id AS ID,
    c.description,
    c.date_added,
    c.image_content,
    c.image_type,
    ct.category_name
FROM components c
LEFT JOIN categories ct ON ct.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT 
  op.order_part_id,
  op.order_id,
  op.quantity_ordered,
  op.unit_cost,
  op.url,
  o.order_date,
  o.delivery_date,
  o.status as order_status,
  v.vendor_id,
  v.vendor_name,
  v.contact_email,
  v.phone_number,
  (op.quantity_ordered * op.unit_cost) as total_cost
FROM order_parts op
INNER JOIN orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
INNER JOIN vendors v ON o.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE op.component_id = {{ $json.body.component_id }}
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC

SELECT 
  pc.project_id,
  pc.component_id,
  pc.quantity_used,
  pc.date,
  p.project_name,
  p.status as project_status,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.is_yt_project,
  p.git_repository
FROM project_components pc
INNER JOIN projects p ON pc.project_id = p.project_id
WHERE pc.component_id = {{ $json.body.component_id }}
ORDER BY pc.date DESC

SELECT 
  usage_id,
  component_id,
  quantity_used,
  usage_date,
  purpose
FROM general_usage
WHERE component_id = {{ $json.body.component_id }}
ORDER BY usage_date DESC
